firm_data.firm_description: Cellino Law is a personal injury law firm serving accident victims throughout New York, Connecticut, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. The firm has roots dating back to 1956.
notable_facts: Ross Cellino, Sr. started practicing law in 1956 and founded Cellino & Likoudis in 1958.
Ross Cellino now heads Cellino Law which focuses his practice on personal injury.

email.subject: AI for Cellino Law, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Ross,

With roots going back to 1956, Cellino Law has built something rare: a trusted personal injury practice across multiple states handling everything from car accidents to catastrophic injuries. That kind of reach demands efficiency without sacrificing the precision your clients expect.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your Manhattan office to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
